description: This file defines a static class with extension methods for the Task class, specifically providing a method to observe and ignore exceptions on tasks to prevent unobserved task exceptions from escalating.

classes.name: PublicOrleansTaskExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for the Task class, including Ignore() to suppress unobserved exceptions.

methods.name: Ignore
methods.description: Extension method that observes and ignores exceptions on a given Task to prevent unobserved exceptions from escalating.
